question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.

The performance he gave was truly __marvelous__.
solution:
The correct answer is** ****'Terrible'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Marvelous" **means extremely good or enjoyable. बहुत अच्छा

 
 
• Example: The magician's tricks were truly marvelous; the audience couldn't stop applauding.
 
 
 
• **"Terrible"** fits this definition, meaning extremely bad or unpleasant.भयानक 
 
• Example: The movie received terrible reviews from the critics; many viewers walked out of the theater disappointed.
 
• Hence, the correct antonym is **'terrible'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is -** 'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Long (लंबा)** - This is not an appropriate antonym for "marvelous," as "long" refers to the length of something and doesn't convey the opposite meaning.
 
• **Option 3: Mesmerizing (मंत्रमुग्ध) **- This is a synonym of "marvelous," meaning captivating or fascinating, so it is not an appropriate antonym.
 
• **Option 4: Interesting (दिलचस्प) -** This word is related to being engaging or appealing, not the opposite of "marvelous."
